fields.description: Members keep earlier reward roles when they earn a higher one; off keeps only the highest.

fields.label: Remove rewards on XP loss
fields.description: Members who lose XP also lose the reward roles above their new level.

fields.label: XP boost roles
fields.description: Members with one of these roles earn more XP; the highest multiplier applies.

groups.title: Rank card
groups.description: The look of the /rank card.

fields.label: Rank card
fields.description: Colours and background of the /rank card.

fields.label: Background image
fields.description: An http(s) link to an image (at most 8 MB). The bot downloads it once to check it.

fields.label: Overlay opacity
fields.description: How much the background image is darkened (0 to 0.9).

achievements.label: Achievements
achievements.description: Tiered achievements for messages, reactions, levels, boosts and purchases, with rewards.

subToggles.label: Announcement as an embed
subToggles.description: Sends achievement unlock announcements as an embed; off sends plain text.

groups.title: Unlock announcements
groups.description: Create and edit the achievements themselves in the list below.

fields.label: Announce unlocks
fields.description: Where unlocks are announced. Boosts and purchases have no channel of their own and use the announcement channel.

fields.label: Announcement channel
fields.description: Used by "Custom channel", and for unlocks that happen outside a channel.

fields.label: Announcement as an embed
fields.description: Sends achievement unlock announcements as an embed; off sends plain text.

fields.label: Announcement message
fields.description: Empty uses the default message.

economy.label: Economy
economy.description: A wallet per server with daily rewards, work, payments, a shop and casino games.

subToggles.label: Copy the legacy global balance
subToggles.description: New accounts start once with the member's balance from the old global wallet.

fields.label: Currency name
fields.description: Shown after every amount, e.g. "250 coins".
fields.patternMessage: Use letters, numbers, spaces and simple punctuation only (no markdown, mentions or newlines).

fields.label: Currency emoji
fields.description: A standard emoji or a custom emoji of this server.

fields.label: Starting balance
fields.description: What a brand-new account starts with. At most the maximum balance.

fields.label: Maximum balance
fields.description: No account can hold more. Lowering it also lowers every balance above the new maximum.

fields.label: Maximum bet
fields.description: The highest bet of a casino game. 0 = no limit beyond the balance.

fields.label: Maximum winnings
fields.description: The highest net win of one casino game. 0 = no limit.

fields.label: Copy the legacy global balance
fields.description: New accounts start once with the member's balance from the old global wallet.

fields.label: Minimum daily reward
fields.description: The smallest /daily payout.

fields.label: Maximum daily reward
fields.description: The largest /daily payout. At least the minimum.

fields.label: Minimum work pay
fields.description: The smallest /work payout.

fields.label: Maximum work pay
fields.description: The largest /work payout. At least the minimum.

fields.label: Work cooldown (minutes)
fields.description: How long a member waits between two /work.

fields.label: Casino games are allowed
fields.description: With an empty list the games work everywhere.

fields.label: Channels
fields.description: Threads count as their parent channel.

games.label: Games
games.description: Rock-paper-scissors, number guessing, tic-tac-toe and two-player Scrabble.

counting.label: Counting
counting.description: A channel where members count up from 1 in turns; a wrong number starts the count again.

groups.title: Counting channel
groups.description: A new channel starts from 1 at the next count. /counting set in Discord also posts the rules there.

fields.label: Counting channel
fields.description: Members count up here, one number per message.

customcommands.label: Custom Commands
customcommands.description: Your own !commands and /tag replies, plus keyword auto-responders.

subToggles.label: Auto-responder triggers
subToggles.description: Replies automatically when a message matches one of your triggers (needs the Custom Commands module on).

fields.label: Auto-responder triggers
fields.description: Replies automatically when a message matches one of your triggers (needs the Custom Commands module on).

automations.label: Automations
automations.description: When-If-Do rules that react to messages, reactions, voice activity, joins and threads.

embeds.label: Embed Messages
embeds.description: Build, save, publish and edit rich embed messages with fields and link buttons.

reminders.label: Reminders
reminders.description: Scheduled channel messages at a time of day, on an interval or once, in the server's time zone.

feeds.label: Social Feeds
feeds.description: Posts new RSS, YouTube, Reddit, Bluesky and podcast items to a channel.

translation.label: Auto-Translate
translation.description: Translates a channel's messages into up to five languages.

search.label: Search Anything
search.description: Look up anime, manga, Pokémon and Urban Dictionary definitions.

subToggles.label: /search urban only in age-restricted channels
subToggles.description: Urban Dictionary lookups only work in age-restricted channels.

fields.label: /search urban only in age-restricted channels
fields.description: Urban Dictionary lookups only work in age-restricted channels.

liverole.label: Live Role
liverole.description: Gives members a role while they stream. Switching it off here leaves it on current streamers; /liverole disable in Discord removes it too.

groups.title: Live role
groups.description: Changes here apply as members start or stop streaming. /liverole set and require in Discord also update current streamers at once.

fields.label: Live role
fields.description: Given while a member streams. Use a role only the bot hands out: members without a stream lose it.

fields.label: Only for members with
fields.description: Only members with this role get the live role. Empty = everyone who streams.

groups.title: Go-live posts
groups.description: Posted when a member goes live and gets the live role, at most once an hour per member. Only the ping role is notified.

fields.label: Post channel
fields.description: Where go-live posts go. Empty turns them off.

fields.label: Message
fields.description: {url} is the stream link. Empty uses the default.

fields.label: Role to ping
fields.description: Mentioned at the start of each post. It only pings if the role is mentionable or the bot has Mention Everyone.

autotime.label: Auto Timestamps
autotime.description: Answers times typed in chat, like "fri 5pm", with a timestamp everyone sees in their own timezone.

groups.title: Ignored channels
groups.description: Times are read in the zone of the member who typed them: their own (/timezone set) or their timezone role.

fields.label: Ignored channels
fields.description: Times typed in these channels are never answered. A category covers its channels and threads.

sticky.label: Sticky Messages
sticky.description: Keeps a message at the bottom of a channel, posting it again as chat moves on.

autothreads.label: Auto Threads
autothreads.description: Opens a thread on every message in chosen channels and publishes announcement posts.

groups.title: Auto threads
groups.description: Every member message in these channels gets its own thread (the bot needs Create Public Threads).

fields.label: Channels
fields.description: Thread names may use {user} (display name), {content} (the start of the message), {channel} and {date}.

itemFields.label: Close button
itemFields.description: Posts a button in each thread that its starter or a moderator can use to close it.

fields.label: Announcement channels
fields.description: New posts here, by members, bots or webhooks, are published to the servers that follow the channel (the bot needs Manage Messages). Discord allows 10 per channel per hour; the rest stay unpublished.

bumps.label: Bump Reminders
bumps.description: Reminds the server to bump it on Disboard when the cooldown ends, and counts who bumps.

subToggles.label: Thank the bumper
subToggles.description: Replies with a thank-you right after a successful bump.

groups.title: Bump reminders
groups.description: Works with Disboard: the bot sees each successful /bump and reminds the server when it can bump again.

fields.label: Reminder channel
fields.description: Reminders are posted here. Empty = the channel of the last bump.

fields.label: Role to ping
fields.description: Pinged with each reminder. Empty = no ping.

fields.label: Reminder message
fields.description: Posted when the server can be bumped again.
fields.default: 📣 The server can be bumped again! Use `/bump` to keep us near the top of Disboard.

fields.label: Thank the bumper
fields.description: Replies with a thank-you right after a successful bump.

fields.label: Thank-you message
fields.description: Sent after each successful bump.
fields.default: 📣 Thanks for bumping, {user}! The next bump is possible {next}.

fields.label: Coins per bump
fields.description: Coins given for each bump while Economy is on. 0 = none.

general.title: General
general.description: Time zone, embed colour and the custom command prefix: settings every module uses.

groups.title: Server settings
groups.description: Settings every module uses.

fields.label: Time zone
fields.description: Used for reminders, birthdays and every other schedule. Changes apply from the next run of each schedule.

fields.label: Embed colour
fields.description: Colour of the bot's informational embeds. Empty uses the default blurple.

fields.label: Custom command prefix
fields.description: Members run custom commands as <prefix>name, e.g. !rules. Empty (or "off") turns prefix commands off; /tag use still works.
fields.patternMessage: The prefix can be at most 5 characters, without spaces or any of ` < > @ # : \ /.

groups.title: Timezone roles
groups.description: Roles such as @CST that give members a time zone in /timestamp (/settings timezone-role).

fields.label: Timezone roles
fields.description: Members with one of these roles get its time zone in /timestamp, unless they saved their own with /timezone set; with several, the highest role wins. Hand the roles out with a Unique reaction-role panel.

embeds.label: Saved embeds
embeds.description: Build messages with an embed and link buttons, post them in any channel and edit the posted message whenever you like. Saved embeds are shared with /embed and the Automations module.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: A short unique name for this embed, also used by /embed in Discord. It cannot be changed later.
fields.patternMessage: Use lowercase letters, numbers, - and _ only (up to 32 characters), e.g. server-rules.

fields.label: Message
fields.description: The text, embed and link buttons. Variables like {server} are filled in when the message is posted; {user} is you. Saving changes also updates the posted message.

readOnly.label: Status
readOnly.description: Draft, or posted in a channel.

readOnly.label: Channel
readOnly.description: Where the message is posted (for a draft: where it was last posted).

actions.label: Post in a channel
actions.description: Posts the message in a channel. If it is already posted, the new copy becomes the one that is kept up to date.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: A text or announcement channel the bot can post in.

fields.label: Delete the previous copy
fields.description: When the embed is already posted somewhere, delete that message (move it). Off: the old message stays but is no longer updated.

actions.label: Update posted message
actions.description: Applies the saved message to the posted copy again, e.g. after the server name changed or a missing permission was fixed.

actions.label: Delete posted message
actions.description: Deletes the posted message from Discord. The saved embed stays as a draft you can post again.
actions.confirm: Delete the posted message from Discord? The saved embed stays as a draft.

tags.label: Custom commands
tags.description: Commands members run with the server prefix (!name) or /tag use: replies with random variations, DMs, messages to other channels and roles to give or take, with access rules and cooldowns.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Members type it after the prefix, e.g. rules for !rules. Lowercase letters, numbers, - and _. It cannot be changed later.
fields.patternMessage: Use lowercase letters, numbers, - and _ only (up to 32 characters), e.g. server-rules.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Shown in /help and /tag list.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off: the command does not answer.

fields.label: Actions
fields.description: What the command does, in order (up to 5). Replies support variables and arguments such as {1}.

itemFields.label: Replies
itemFields.description: Reply, DM and send actions: one of these is picked at random each time.

itemFields.label: Reply
itemFields.description: Up to 2,000 characters, or 4,000 when sent as an embed.

itemFields.label: Send as an embed
itemFields.description: Reply, DM and send actions only.

itemFields.label: Channel
itemFields.description: "Send to a channel" only: where the message goes.

itemFields.label: Role
itemFields.description: Role actions only. It must be below the bot's highest role and carry no moderator permissions.

itemFields.label: Roles the message may ping
itemFields.description: Reply and send actions: role mentions in the text only ping these roles. DMs never ping.

fields.label: Allowed roles
fields.description: Only members with one of these roles may use it. Empty: everyone.

fields.label: Denied roles
fields.description: Members with one of these roles may not use it.

fields.label: Allowed channels
fields.description: Only works in these channels or categories. Empty: everywhere.

fields.label: Denied channels
fields.description: Never works in these channels or categories.

fields.label: Cooldown length
fields.description: How long before it can be used again (up to 365 days).

fields.label: Delete the !name message
fields.description: Deletes the member's message after the command ran (prefix use only; the bot needs Manage Messages).

triggers.label: Auto-responders
triggers.description: Automatic replies to messages that contain a keyword or match a pattern. They answer while the Custom Commands module and its auto-responder switch are on.

fields.label: Keyword or pattern
fields.description: The word, phrase or regular expression to watch for.

fields.label: Response
fields.description: The reply. Variables such as {user} and {channel} work.

fields.label: Cooldown per member
fields.description: How long one member waits before it answers them again (0 = no cooldown).

fields.label: Delete the matching message
fields.description: The bot needs Manage Messages for this.

fields.label: Only in these channels
fields.description: Empty: every channel. Threads count as their parent channel.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off: paused, the settings are kept.

reminders.label: Reminders
reminders.description: Messages the bot posts on a schedule: at a time of day, every few minutes or hours, or once. Times of day use the server time zone from the General settings.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: A short unique name, also used by /reminder in Discord. It cannot be changed later.
fields.patternMessage: Use lowercase letters, numbers, - and _ only (up to 32 characters), e.g. server-rules.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Where the reminder is posted.

fields.label: Message
fields.description: Server and channel variables work. Reminders have no member, so {user} variables are posted as written.

fields.label: Time of day
fields.description: "At a time of day": when it is posted, in the server time zone.

fields.label: Days
fields.description: "At a time of day" and "Every interval": the days it runs on. None selected: every day.

fields.label: Interval
fields.description: "Every interval": time between posts, 5 minutes to 7 days (10080 minutes).

fields.label: Daily start
fields.description: "Every interval": only post from this time of day (needs an interval under 24 hours). Empty: from midnight.

fields.label: Daily stop
fields.description: "Every interval": stop posting at this time of day. Empty: until midnight.

fields.label: Date and time
fields.description: "Once": when it is posted (within one year).

fields.label: Skip when the channel is quiet
fields.description: Not posted unless someone chatted since the last reminder (not for "Once").

fields.label: Role to ping
fields.description: Mentioned at the start of every reminder.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off: paused, nothing is posted.

actions.label: Send a test
actions.description: Posts the reminder once now as a preview. Roles are not pinged and the schedule is not touched.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Where to post the test. Empty: the reminder's channel.

feeds.label: Social feeds
feeds.description: Post new RSS items, YouTube uploads, Reddit posts, Bluesky posts and podcast episodes in a channel. Each feed is checked every 5 to 30 minutes; only items published after it was added are posted.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: RSS: the feed URL or a site that links to its feed. YouTube: the UC… channel ID or a youtube.com/channel/UC… link (@handles are not supported). Reddit: the subreddit, e.g. r/aww. Bluesky: a handle, profile link or DID. Podcast: its name to search for, or its RSS feed URL. It cannot be changed later.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Where new items are posted.

fields.label: Role to ping
fields.description: Mentioned with every new item.

fields.label: Message
fields.description: Empty: the default message for this kind of feed. Variables: {title} {link} {author} {feed}, plus {youtube_channel} (YouTube), {subreddit} (Reddit), {bluesky_name} {bluesky_handle} (Bluesky), {podcast_title} {episode_title} (podcasts). Feeds have no member, so {user} variables do not work.

fields.label: Include reposts
fields.description: Bluesky only: also post reposts.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off: paused, the settings are kept. Turning it back on resets its failures; items published while it was off are skipped.

actions.label: Check now
actions.description: Fetches the feed once and shows its newest item. Nothing is posted or changed.

levelRoles.label: Level rewards
levelRoles.description: Roles members earn when they reach a level. Adding a reward does not give the role to members who are already past that level: run /levelconfig role sync in Discord for that. Members who already have a role keep it when you remove its reward. Whether lower rewards are kept is set under "Keep lower reward roles".

fields.label: Level
fields.description: Members get the role as soon as they reach this level. Each level has one reward.

fields.label: Reward role
fields.description: The role the bot gives. It must be below the bot's highest role, and each role can be the reward for one level only.

readOnly.label: Reward
readOnly.description: The level this reward is for.

shopItems.label: Shop items
shopItems.description: What members can buy with /shop buy. Deleting an item also deletes every copy members own. Role items need a role the bot can give (it must be below the bot's highest role).

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Shown in /shop and used to pick the item. Unique on this server (upper and lower case count as the same).

fields.label: Price
fields.description: What one copy costs, in the server currency.

fields.label: Type
fields.description: Collectible items just sit in the inventory. Usable items are used with /use. Role items give a role.

fields.label: Role
fields.description: The role a Role item gives. Only for Role items; it must be below the bot's highest role.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Shown in the shop.

fields.label: Image link
fields.description: A picture shown with the item (an http or https link).

fields.label: Use on purchase
fields.description: The item is used the moment it is bought. Not for collectible items.

fields.label: Used up on use
fields.description: Each use removes one copy from the inventory.

fields.label: Allow several copies
fields.description: Members may own more than one copy (up to the limit below). Off: one per member.

fields.label: Copies per member
fields.description: The most copies one member may own.

fields.label: Stock
fields.description: Copies left for sale. Empty means unlimited; 0 means sold out.

fields.label: Purchase message
fields.description: Shown after a purchase. Empty uses the default message.

fields.label: Use message
fields.description: Shown after the item is used. Empty uses the default message.

fields.label: In the shop
fields.description: Off hides the item from /shop and stops purchases. Copies members own are kept.

achievements.label: Achievements
achievements.description: Goals members work towards (messages, reactions, levels, boosts, purchases), with up to four tiers and rewards. Deleting an achievement deletes every member's progress on it; roles, XP and coins already given are kept. The bot picks up changes within about 30 seconds.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Unique on this server (upper and lower case count as the same).

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Short text shown in /achievements.

fields.label: Badge
fields.description: One emoji shown next to the name. Empty uses the default badge of the trigger. A custom emoji must come from a server the bot is in.

fields.label: What members do
fields.description: What counts as progress. Cannot be changed later. Level achievements need the Levels module, purchase achievements the Economy module.

fields.label: Tiers
fields.description: Up to four goals, lowest first: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Diamond. Members unlock a tier when they reach its goal and get its rewards. Tiers are matched by position when you change them: removing the last tier keeps rewards already given, and members who already passed a lowered goal unlock it with their next activity.

itemFields.label: Goal
itemFields.description: What a member has to reach for this tier. Goals go up from tier to tier.

itemFields.label: Give this role
itemFields.description: Reward: a role the bot gives. It must be below the bot's highest role.

itemFields.label: Take this role away
itemFields.description: Reward: a role the bot removes. It must be below the bot's highest role.

itemFields.label: XP reward
itemFields.description: Reward: XP. Needs the Levels module to be on.

itemFields.label: Coin reward
itemFields.description: Reward: coins. Needs the Economy module to be on.

fields.label: Count past activity
fields.description: Off: members start from zero when the achievement is created. Only applies to members who have no progress yet.

fields.label: Deadline
fields.description: The last moment members can make progress (between a minute and five years from now). Empty means no deadline.

fields.label: On
fields.description: Off: nothing is counted until you turn it back on. Progress is kept.

readOnly.label: Members with progress
readOnly.description: How many members have started this achievement.

starboards.label: Starboards
starboards.description: Boards that repost popular messages to a channel. Deleting a board keeps its reposts, but they stop updating. The bot picks up changes within about a minute.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (up to 32). Unique on this server.
fields.patternMessage: The name may only use lowercase letters a-z, digits, - and _.

fields.label: Repost channel
fields.description: Where popular messages are reposted. Changing it reposts live entries into the new channel; old reposts stay where they are.

fields.label: Emojis that count
fields.description: Reactions that count towards the threshold: an emoji, or a custom emoji as <:name:id> or just its ID. Empty means every emoji counts.

fields.label: Reactions needed
fields.description: How many counting reactions a message needs to be reposted.

fields.label: Count the author's own reaction
fields.description: Off: a member reacting to their own message does not count.

fields.label: Remove the author's own reaction
fields.description: The bot removes a member's own qualifying reaction (needs Manage Messages). Cannot be combined with counting it.

fields.label: Ignore bots
fields.description: Ignore messages from bots and reactions by bots.

fields.label: Remove the repost below the threshold
fields.description: Delete the repost when the message falls below the threshold again.

fields.label: React to the repost
fields.description: The bot adds the first counting emoji to the repost (needs Add Reactions and Read Message History).

fields.label: Ignore older messages
fields.description: Messages older than this many days are never reposted. 0 means no limit.

fields.label: Repost from age-restricted channels
fields.description: The repost channel must be age-restricted too.

fields.label: Ignored channels
fields.description: Messages in these channels (or categories) never reach this board.

fields.label: On
fields.description: Off: nothing is reposted by this board.

readOnly.label: Live reposts
readOnly.description: Messages this board currently has reposted.

translateChannels.label: Translated channels
translateChannels.description: Channels where the bot translates every message. Adding the first channel also turns the Auto-Translate module on, like /autotranslate does. Deleting a channel here only stops the translating. The bot picks up changes within about 30 seconds.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Messages posted here are translated by the bot. Text, announcement, voice and stage channels (their chat) work; threads are set up with /autotranslate in Discord.

fields.label: Translate into
fields.description: Up to five languages. Every message is translated into each of them (the bot posts a reply with the translations).

translateStats.label: Channels by translation activity
translateStats.description: Per channel: how many messages were translated (auto-translate replies and /translate), the languages members write in and the languages they were translated into. Only counts are kept, never the messages.

readOnly.label: Members write in
readOnly.description: The language of each translated message, as the translation service detected it.

tempVoiceHubs.label: Voice hubs
tempVoiceHubs.description: Join-to-create voice channels. Deleting a hub here only removes its settings and is refused while its temporary channels are open; the hub channel itself stays in Discord (use /voice-hub delete to remove channels too). The bot notices new, changed and deleted hubs within about 5 minutes.

fields.label: Hub channel
fields.description: The voice channel members join to get their own channel. Pick an existing voice channel; this page cannot create one (/voice-hub create can do that in Discord). It cannot be changed later.

fields.label: Category for new channels
fields.description: Where the temporary channels are created. Empty uses the hub channel's own category.

fields.label: Channel name
fields.description: The name of each new channel. {index} is the channel number and {username} the owner's name. Mentions such as {user} are not allowed.

fields.label: User limit
fields.description: How many members fit in a new channel. 0 means no limit.

fields.label: Bitrate
fields.description: Audio quality of new channels. Empty uses Discord's default. The server's boost level caps it.

fields.label: Keep empty channels
fields.description: How long an empty channel survives before it is deleted. 0 deletes it at once.

fields.label: Ownership lock
fields.description: How long after the owner leaves before someone else can claim the channel with /voice claim. 0 means at once.

fields.label: Copy the category's permissions
fields.description: On: new channels copy the category's permissions. Off: they copy the hub channel's.

fields.label: Create a text channel too
fields.description: Each new voice channel gets a companion text channel.

fields.label: Text channel only for voice members
fields.description: Only members currently in the voice channel can see its text channel.

fields.label: Protected roles
fields.description: /voice commands do not affect members with these roles: they cannot be kicked or banned, and locking or hiding does not shut them out.

fields.label: Moderator roles
fields.description: Members with these roles can use every /voice command on any channel from this hub.

readOnly.label: Open channels
readOnly.description: Temporary channels from this hub that exist right now.

statChannels.label: Counter channels
statChannels.description: Voice channels renamed about every 10 minutes to show a live number (members, online, boosts, ...). Discord allows only a few renames per channel, so a name can lag a few minutes. Deleting a counter here only stops the updates; the channel stays in Discord with its last name. Channels that /stats create makes (locked for @everyone) can be edited and deleted here.

fields.label: What to count
fields.description: The number the channel name shows. Cannot be changed later. Only the Online and Peak online counters need the bot to see presences.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: An existing voice channel that the bot renames. Pick a dedicated one: its name is replaced. Deny Connect for @everyone on it so nobody joins (/stats create in Discord does that for you). It cannot be changed later.

fields.label: Role to count
fields.description: Only for "Role members": whose members are counted. The role is only counted, never given. Cannot be changed later.

fields.label: Channel name
fields.description: The channel name; {count} is replaced by the number ({role} by the role name for "Role members"). Empty uses the default for the counter type, e.g. "Members: {count}".

readOnly.label: Showing
readOnly.description: The number in the channel name at the last update.

readOnly.label: Peak
readOnly.description: The highest online count seen (Peak online only).

actions.label: Update the counters now
actions.description: Asks the bot to update every counter channel of this server within about a minute (/stats refresh). Discord still limits how often a channel can be renamed, so a name can lag a few minutes. The Statistics Channels module must be on.

economyBoosts.label: Coin boosts
economyBoosts.description: A boost multiplies one /daily or /work payout for a member who holds its role (or for everyone). Only the highest boost a member has not used up in the current period applies. Rewards, /pay, casino winnings and admin grants are never boosted.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Unique on this server (upper and lower case count as the same).

fields.label: Bonus
fields.description: Extra coins in percent: 50 turns a payout of 100 coins into 150.

fields.label: How often one member can use it
fields.description: One-time: once per member, ever. The others: once per day, ISO week or month in the server time zone. Cannot be changed later; delete the boost and create a new one for that.

fields.label: Only members with this role
fields.description: Leave empty so every member qualifies. The role is only checked, never given.

fields.label: On
fields.description: A boost that is off is ignored. Its usage history is kept.

Moderation & Safety

Keep the server safe with moderation tools, automatic filters, audit logs and member verification.

MdModeration

Ban, kick, timeout and warn with case history and escalation.

On when the bot joins. Turn it off with /module disable moderation. Set it up with /modconfig.

Settings and their defaults
SettingDefaultWhat it does
DM members when punishedOnMembers get a direct message when they are warned, timed out, kicked or banned.
Command visibilityPublicWho sees the confirmation of a moderation command.
  • /banModerators

    Ban a user, optionally for a set time

  • /caseModerators

    View or edit a moderation case, or list or clear a member's infractions.

    • /case view View a case.
    • /case reason Change a case's reason.
    • /case proof Set a case's proof link.
    • /case history List a member's moderation cases
    • /case clear-history Pardon all of a member's active warnings
  • /kickModerators

    Kick a member from the server

  • /modconfigAdmins

    Moderator settings: escalation, immune and mod roles, mute role, case log, visibility.

    • /modconfig escalation add Add or update a tier: N warnings within a period, then an action.
    • /modconfig escalation remove Remove an escalation tier.
    • /modconfig escalation list List the escalation tiers.
    • /modconfig immune add Make a role immune.
    • /modconfig immune remove Remove a role from the immune list.
    • /modconfig immune list List the immune roles.
    • /modconfig modroles add Give a role moderator access.
    • /modconfig modroles remove Remove a moderator role.
    • /modconfig modroles list List the moderator roles.
    • /modconfig muterole Set, create or clear the mute role (used for mutes over 28 days).
    • /modconfig logchannel Set or clear the channel for moderation case logs.
    • /modconfig visibility Who sees moderation command replies
    • /modconfig dm Turn DMs to punished members on or off.
    • /modconfig show Show the current moderation settings.
  • /purgeModerators

    Bulk-delete recent messages in this channel

  • /slowmodeModerators

    Set or remove a channel's slowmode

  • /softbanModerators

    Ban and instantly unban a user to delete their recent messages.

  • /timeoutModerators

    Time out a member; over 28 days uses the mute role

  • /unbanModerators

    Lift a ban by user ID

  • /unmuteModerators

    Remove a member's timeout or mute role

  • /warnModerators

    Warn a member; warnings can trigger automatic actions

AmAuto-Moderation

Automatically removes or punishes bad words, spam, invites, links, caps, mass mentions and more.

Off until you run /module enable automod or flip its switch on the dashboard. Set it up with /automod.

Configured with its commands and the lists on the dashboard.

  • /automodAdmins

    Auto-moderation rules, actions and exemptions

    • /automod enable Turn automod on. Your rules and lists stay as they are.
    • /automod disable Turn automod off. Rules and lists are kept.
    • /automod status Show every rule with its action and scope, the lists and the exemptions.
    • /automod rule Set a rule's action, threshold and scope (Bad Words, Caps, Anti-Spam, …).
    • /automod words add Add words or phrases (comma-separated).
    • /automod words remove Remove a word or phrase.
    • /automod words list List the filtered words (only you can see the list).
    • /automod patterns add Add a case-insensitive regex pattern.
    • /automod patterns remove Remove a regex pattern.
    • /automod patterns list List the regex patterns (only you can see the list).
    • /automod domains add Add a domain to the blocked or allowed list.
    • /automod domains remove Remove a domain from the blocked and allowed lists.
    • /automod domains list Show the blocked and allowed domains.
    • /automod exempt add Add a role and/or channel to the exemptions or to a rule's list.
    • /automod exempt remove Remove a role and/or channel from the exemptions or a rule's list.
    • /automod honeypot add Make a channel a honeypot, or create one.
    • /automod honeypot remove Stop a channel being a honeypot (the channel is kept).

LgAudit Logs

Posts message, member, voice, channel, role and server events to your log channels.

Off until you run /module enable logging or flip its switch on the dashboard. Set it up with /logging.

Configured with its commands and the lists on the dashboard.

  • /loggingAdmins

    Audit logs: turn on/off, pick log channels, toggle events

    • /logging enable Turn audit logging on.
    • /logging disable Turn audit logging off (settings are kept).
    • /logging status Show log channels, disabled events and ignored channels.
    • /logging channel Set or clear the channel for a log type.
    • /logging event Turn one log event (or all) on or off.
    • /logging ignore add Stop logging message events in a channel or category.
    • /logging ignore remove Log message events in a channel again.
    • /logging ignore list List ignored channels.

CpVerification

New members solve a captcha before they get access; those who never verify can be kicked.

Off until you run /module enable captcha or flip its switch on the dashboard. Set it up with /captcha.

Settings and their defaults
SettingDefaultWhat it does
Captcha typeImage codeImage: type the code from a picture. Button: one click.
Kick unverified members after (minutes)00 never kicks; otherwise 5 to 10080 minutes (7 days). Setting 0 cancels the kicks already scheduled.
  • /captchaAdmins

    Captcha verification for new members

    • /captcha setup Create or reuse #verification and the role, then post the panel.
    • /captcha enable Turn verification on.
    • /captcha disable Turn verification off (settings are kept).
    • /captcha status Show the settings and any problems.
    • /captcha mode Image code or one-click button.
    • /captcha role Set the verified role.
    • /captcha require Roles needed to verify, and a form for those without (no options: show).
    • /captcha channel Move the panel to another channel.
    • /captcha timeout Kick members who do not verify in time.
    • /captcha message Edit the panel (no options opens a form).
    • /captcha lock Hide channels until members verify
    • /captcha verify-existing Give the verified role to current members.

ArAnti-Raid

Spots join floods and brand-new accounts, pauses invites and alerts your moderators.

Off until you run /module enable antiraid or flip its switch on the dashboard. Set it up with /antiraid.

Settings and their defaults
SettingDefaultWhat it does
Joins10How many joins in the window count as a raid.
Window10 secondsThe window the joins are counted in.
Members who join during a raidOnly alert the moderatorsWhat happens to members who join while a raid lockdown lasts.
Pause invitesOnPauses every invite while the lockdown lasts (the bot needs Manage Server).
Lock chatOffTakes Send Messages from @everyone while the lockdown lasts and gives it back afterwards (the bot needs Manage Roles).
Lockdown length30 minutesThe lockdown lifts itself after this long.
Minimum account age0 daysAccounts younger than this get the action below. 0 = off.
Action for new accountsKick themWhat happens to accounts younger than the minimum age when they join.
  • /antiraidAdmins

    Raid protection: join floods, lockdowns and brand-new accounts.

    • /antiraid status Show the lockdown, settings and problems.
    • /antiraid lockdown start Start a lockdown now.
    • /antiraid lockdown end End it and undo what it changed.

changelog.markdown:
# Changelog

What changed in Frost.Byte, newest first. Each entry is dated by when it landed on `main`; there are no version numbers yet. The full history is in the [commit log](https://github.com/MasstarVT/discord-bot/commits/main).

## 2026-10-27 · Commands-only channels and maths in Counting
- New Automations preset **Commands Only**: `/automation create preset:Commands Only channel:#bot-commands` deletes every message in that channel that does not start with your custom-command prefix, so only commands are used there. Slash commands keep working, and members with the moderator roles (or the `role` you pick) can still talk. Also on the dashboard's Automations page.
- Counting accepts maths: `2+2`, `(3*4)-1` or `2^3` counts as the number it comes to. Sums that come to a fraction, such as `10/27`, are treated as chat and never reset the count.

## 2026-10-21 · Go-live posts for the Live Role
- The Live Role can now post in a channel when a member goes live, with a link to their Twitch or YouTube stream. Set it up with `/liverole announce channel:#live-now`, or on the dashboard; the message can be customised with `{url}`, `{platform}`, `{title}` and `{game}`, and `ping_role` pings a role such as @Stream Alerts with each post.

## 2026-10-20 · Auto Timestamps and a new site
- A new public site: the landing page opens every module to show its commands and default settings, runs sample commands with the bot's real replies, and lets you try the Levels settings. New `/docs` and `/changelog` pages list every module, command and change.
- New module **Auto Timestamps**: when a member types a time such as "friday 5pm" or "7pm EST", the bot replies with a Discord timestamp everyone reads in their own timezone. `/autotime enable` turns it on.
- Members with no timezone set are told how to pick a timezone role or use `/timezone set`.
- The dashboard's Audit Logs page lists every event that gets logged.

## 2026-10-19 · Public landing page and legal pages
- The dashboard got a new look, and the bot got a public landing page.
- Added a privacy policy and terms of service, plus trusted-proxy settings so the dashboard can be served publicly.
- Dependency security updates (js-yaml, brace-expansion, ip-address).

## 2026-10-18 · Honeypot channels
- Automod can now watch **honeypot channels**: whoever posts in one is softbanned (or banned, kicked or timed out) at once, which catches spam bots and hacked accounts. `/automod honeypot add` can create the channel and post a warning in it.

## 2026-10-17 · More reaction-role templates
- Reaction roles gained ready-made role sets: pronouns, colours, age ranges and more.

## 2026-10-16 · Timezones
- Added `/timestamp`, `/timezone` and timezone roles, so times show up in each member's own timezone.
- Timezone reaction-role templates in `/reactionrole` and the dashboard, and a timezone-roles editor on the dashboard's General page.
- Custom commands limited to certain roles are now hidden from members who can't run them.

## 2026-10-15 · Performance and fixes
- A performance pass across the bot, including buffered achievement message counts.
- Added `/owner`, which pings the bot owner.
- Fixed the bugs found in a full codebase review.

## 2026-10-14 · Counting
- New module **Counting**: members count up from 1 in turns; a wrong number or a double turn starts it over.
- The bot owner can see who added the bot to each server.

## 2026-10-13 · Dashboard access
- The dashboard shows only the servers you manage; the bot owner can manage, and join, any server the bot is in.
- Translation activity per channel on the dashboard.
- Setup commands can create the role or channel they ask for.
- Moderator commands now require default member permissions too.

## 2026-10-11 · The web dashboard
- Added the web dashboard: log in with Discord and change every module's settings in a browser.
- Manage saved embeds, custom commands, reminders, feeds, level rewards, the shop and achievements from it.
- Run giveaways and polls, build automations, manage reaction-role and ticket panels, and moderate members (XP and coins too) from the dashboard.
- An embed editor, member pickers and long-list paging.
- The bot itself was rebuilt for feature parity with MEE6, with the audited bugs fixed.

## 2026-09-27 · Docker and CI
- Docker image, health endpoints, CI with GitHub Container Registry publishing, rollback and Dependabot.
- A LibreTranslate backend for translation, with back-off on rate limits.
- A failing event handler no longer restarts the bot; a shard that disconnects for good stops it cleanly.

## 2026-08-23 · README and license
- Added the README and the MIT license.

## 2026-06-11 · First version
- The first version of the bot, including the games command and Scrabble.

  • Added the web dashboard: log in with Discord and change every module's settings in a browser.
  • Manage saved embeds, custom commands, reminders, feeds, level rewards, the shop and achievements from it.
  • Run giveaways and polls, build automations, manage reaction-role and ticket panels, and moderate members (XP and coins too) from the dashboard.
  • An embed editor, member pickers and long-list paging.
  • The bot itself was rebuilt for feature parity with MEE6, with the audited bugs fixed.

Docker and CI

LOT 2026-09-27

  • Docker image, health endpoints, CI with GitHub Container Registry publishing, rollback and Dependabot.
  • A LibreTranslate backend for translation, with back-off on rate limits.
  • A failing event handler no longer restarts the bot; a shard that disconnects for good stops it cleanly.

README and license

LOT 2026-08-23

  • Added the README and the MIT license.

First version

LOT 2026-06-11

  • The first version of the bot, including the games command and Scrabble.
